steps: Fresh install / wallet with no conversations. Open ZCHAT to the Chat tab. Observe the chat list area.
expected: A clear empty-state (illustration/text inviting first chat), no blank scroll area, no crash. Bottom nav + top bar render correctly.
edgeCases: 0 conversations; immediately after wallet create (no messages anywhere).

flow: Chat list — search empty + special chars
steps: With at least 2 conversations, tap the search field. Type a term that matches nothing (e.g. 'zzzznomatch'). Then clear and type a term with quotes/backslash like test"quote and hello\\world.
expected: 'No conversations match …' message shown; with quote/backslash input the message renders cleanly without nested/escaped-quote garbling (verifies empty-search-result-string-literal fix).
edgeCases: empty query (all convos show); whitespace-only query; quotes; backslash; max-length query (paste 500 chars).

flow: Chat list — Destroy All PIN setup gate
steps: Open the Destroy All dialog from chat list overflow. In the PIN field type '1234'; in confirm type 'x'. Observe 'Set PIN & Continue' button. Then make confirm '1234'.
expected: With mismatched PIN ('1234' vs 'x') the button is DISABLED (verifies pin-setup-button-mismatch fix). With matching '1234'/'1234' it enables and proceeds. No 'PINs do not match' error reachable via an enabled button.
edgeCases: 3-digit PIN (disabled); empty confirm (disabled); whitespace PIN; matching but <4 chars.

steps: On Honor open/compose a chat to Seeker's u-address, ensure mode = VAULT. Type 'hello' and send. On Seeker observe receipt; reply 'hi back'.
expected: Message sends, shows sent/delivered state, appears on Seeker decrypted; reply returns to Honor. Lock/E2E indicator reflects VAULT.
edgeCases: first-contact (KEX exchange) — verify no 'Unknown sender, can't reply'; empty message (send disabled); whitespace-only message (send disabled).

steps: In the same chat switch mode to TUNNEL. Send a message Honor→Seeker and reply back.
expected: Mode indicator updates to TUNNEL; messages route and decrypt correctly both directions.
edgeCases: switching mode mid-conversation; first message in new mode; mode-change warning timing.

steps: Switch the chat to OPEN mode. Send Honor→Seeker and reply.
expected: Mode indicator shows OPEN; message delivered; any reduced-privacy warning shown appropriately.
edgeCases: first message in OPEN; verify no leakage of VAULT-only affordances.

steps: Open a conversation whose peer address is unknown/invalid (or simulate first-contact-without-address). Try to type, tap the + attach menu, and the mic button.
expected: Input/send/attach/mic all disabled with an OBVIOUS read-only banner/warning (verifies send-disabled-on-invalid-address improvement); disabled controls clearly distinguishable from enabled in both Nightwire dark and Light themes.
edgeCases: key-changed banner present; Nightwire vs Light theme contrast on mic/attach.

steps: In an active chat, paste ~10,000 chars into the message input.
expected: Counter visible (e.g. 'N / 5000'), input capped at 5000 with a truncation toast/warning rather than silent drop (verifies max-message-length-truncation-silent fix).
edgeCases: exactly 5000 chars; 5001 chars; paste vs type; 512-byte memo-boundary message still sends as a single memo.

steps: In a chat where E2E is pending (LockClock icon), rapidly tap the lock icon ~5 times.
expected: Toggle is disabled/non-repeating while pending (verifies e2e-toggle-no-loading-state fix); only one KEX is initiated; no duplicate-key races.
edgeCases: toggle off→on→off quickly; toggle during active send.

steps: Long-press a message and choose Reply. Observe the reply preview. Cancel the reply. In a long chat, start a reply and scroll.
expected: Reply preview shows; a discoverable cancel (X and/or inline cancel/back) clears reply mode (verifies reply-preview-missing-cancel-affordance improvement).
edgeCases: reply in a very long chat; back-button cancels reply; send while replying quotes correctly.

steps: Open chat overflow → set/edit nickname. Clear the field to empty/whitespace and observe Save. Then enter a valid nickname and Save.
expected: Save is DISABLED for empty/whitespace (verifies nickname-save-button-always-enabled fix); valid nickname persists and shows in title/list.
edgeCases: whitespace-only; very long nickname (max-length); emoji nickname; clearing an existing nickname intentionally.

steps: Send a photo, a view-once photo, and a voice message Honor→Seeker. On Seeker, attempt to view each. Force a download failure (toggle network off mid-download) for the view-once photo and the voice message.
expected: Regular file shows 'Tap to retry' on failure; view-once shows a retry affordance instead of永perpetual 'Downloading…' (verifies missing-file-download-failure-handling); voice play button clearly disabled (high contrast) until ready (verifies voice-message-ready-state-ui).
edgeCases: no network during download; very old message missing ZFILE content; tapping disabled voice play; view-once already-viewed state.

steps: Open a received image fullscreen; force its download to fail (network off). Tap the 'Download failed — tap to retry' button. Then open an old image whose fileZfileContent is missing.
expected: Retry works when ZFILE content exists; when fileZfileContent is null the button is hidden or shows 'Cannot retry — data missing' instead of a dead button (verifies fullscreen-image-missing-retry-state).
edgeCases: null fileZfileContent; repeated retries; network restored mid-retry.

steps: Open a chat with several messages, tap message-search, enter a non-matching query.
expected: Header shows '0 results found' AND the empty area shows 'No messages match your search' (NOT 'No messages yet') — verifies search-empty-results-misleading-text.
edgeCases: 0 results; query with special chars; clearing search restores full list.

steps: Start a regular voice recording, then a view-once voice recording.
expected: View-once recording is visually distinct from regular (icon AND tint), per the intended danger-color cue (verifies recording-ui-color-inconsistency fix).
edgeCases: cancel recording; switch between view-once and regular before recording.

steps: On a wallet with 0 ZEC spendable, open the Compose/send screen and enter a valid recipient. Open the amount (Adjust) dialog.
expected: 'Available: 0 ZEC' shown on both the compose screen and the amount dialog (verifies compose-balance-hidden-when-zero), ideally in error color.
edgeCases: 0 balance; balance just below fee; balance updating (sync in progress).

steps: With valid recipient+message, select amount = ZERO; observe Send. Then on a near-empty wallet select SEND_ALL.
expected: Send is disabled (or requires explicit confirm) when amount is zero, and SEND_ALL that yields 0-to-recipient does not allow a silent 0-amount send (verifies compose-zero-amount-send-allowed).
edgeCases: ZERO amount; SEND_ALL on insufficient balance; SEND_ALL on exactly-fee balance.

steps: On the compose/send screen, type/paste a message longer than maxMessageLength (e.g. 5000 chars when max ~4500).
expected: Counter turns red and Send is DISABLED (or input is capped) above maxMessageLength (verifies compose-max-length-not-enforced); no opaque downstream chunk error.
edgeCases: exactly max; max+1; paste vs type.

steps: Select CUSTOM amount. Type '999999999999999.9'. Then type '0.50'.
expected: Huge input is rejected/capped to a realistic max (no Long overflow display); sub-dollar/decimal handled sensibly without misleading display (verifies compose-custom-amount-overflow).
edgeCases: value > Long.MAX zatoshi; many decimal places; '0'; '0.00000001' (1 zatoshi).

steps: With valid recipient, amount, and message and sufficient balance, tap Send and complete the biometric/PIN prompt (Honor PIN ***REMOVED*** / Seeker PIN ***REMOVED***). Confirm the transaction.
expected: Biometric prompt appears; on success the send proceeds and a success/confirmation state shows; on cancel the user returns to compose without sending.
edgeCases: biometric cancel; wrong PIN; biometric prompt blocks screenshots (expected); back during confirm.

steps: Trigger compose initial-load failure (e.g. force getDefaultUnifiedAddress to throw / open send while account unavailable).
expected: Error screen exposes Back and Retry (verifies compose-error-state-no-recovery); user is not stranded.
edgeCases: retry succeeds after transient failure; back from error returns to chat.

steps: Open compose with no recipient; note MODE selector absent. Paste a valid address.
expected: MODE selector appears with a label/description (or is shown always-but-disabled per fix) — verifies compose-mode-selector-visibility-unclear improvement; not jarring.
edgeCases: invalid→valid→invalid address toggling; address with surrounding whitespace.

flow: Send/compose — add contact from address (whitespace name)
steps: In compose tap the Add-contact icon next to a pasted address. Enter a name of only spaces; observe Confirm. Then enter a real name.
expected: Confirm DISABLED for whitespace-only name (verifies contact-name-address-trim-inconsistency / compose-add-contact-name-whitespace-only); real name saved trimmed.
edgeCases: leading/trailing spaces; tab/newline; max-length name; duplicate name.

steps: Open Receive (My Address). Tap Copy Address; paste into the message field to verify. Tap Share Address. Toggle Show Shielded / Show Transparent.
expected: Correct non-empty address copied ('Address copied!' toast); share sheet contains the address; toggle switches address+badge correctly.
edgeCases: empty/corrupt address must not copy/share empty (verifies receive-empty-address-handling); transparent-address warning visible.

steps: Simulate account-load failure (e.g. open Receive before sync / with corrupted account).
expected: An error message + Retry shows instead of an infinite spinner (verifies receive-no-error-state).
edgeCases: transient failure then retry succeeds; offline.

steps: Enable TalkBack. Navigate Receive: badge icon, Info icons, Copy/Share buttons.
expected: Badge and Info icons announce meaningful descriptions (verifies receive-missing-icon-descriptions); buttons announce their action.
edgeCases: TalkBack swipe order; localized labels once strings.xml added.

steps: On Honor, create a new group: enter a name, add Seeker (+ self) as members, tap Create Group and watch the loading state.
expected: During creation the button shows 'Creating…' text + spinner (verifies create-group-button-no-label); group is created and appears in list; Seeker receives invite.
edgeCases: empty group name (create disabled); whitespace name; very long group name (50+ chars) wraps/truncates gracefully; 0 members; max members.

steps: In the created group, send a message from Honor; verify Seeker receives it. Force a key-missing condition (e.g. Seeker misses a key rotation) and have Honor send again.
expected: Normal messages decrypt for all members; undecryptable message shows the key-missing fallback WITH a 'Sync group keys' / recovery action (verifies group-message-display-fallback-no-recovery).
edgeCases: key rotation/epoch change; member who joined after rotation; admin vs non-admin.

steps: Open Group Settings. Tap the Copy Group ID icon. Review the member list (note Admin badge). Tap Leave Group.
expected: Copy-ID icon is an easy 48dp tap target (verifies copy-group-id-button-undersized); members list shows; with TalkBack the Admin star announces 'Admin badge' (verifies group-settings-icon-without-description); leave works.
edgeCases: 0-member group shows 'No members' (verifies group-settings-empty-members-state); group icon a11y in detail top bar; leaving as the only admin.

flow: AI chat — first launch model loading
steps: Force-stop the app, reopen, go to AI tab immediately (before models load). Observe the model picker and composer.
expected: Model picker shows 'Loading…' WITH a spinner; composer shows an inline hint ('Loading models…'/'Select a model'); Send button appearance matches its disabled state (verifies ai-model-null-disables-controls-no-explanation).
edgeCases: slow network; models fail to load; tapping disabled composer/Send.

steps: On the AI tab tap the 'Model' label text (not just the arrow). Pick a model. Send a chat prompt and get a reply.
expected: Tapping anywhere on the picker row opens the dropdown (verifies model-picker-row-not-clickable); selected model persists; chat reply streams in.
edgeCases: switch model mid-conversation; empty prompt (Send disabled); whitespace prompt.

flow: AI chat — models load failure + retry
steps: With network off, open AI tab so model load fails. Open the error banner and the model dropdown.
expected: Error banner offers Retry (not just Dismiss) and/or empty dropdown offers Retry; restoring network + Retry recovers without app restart (verifies empty-models-list-no-retry).
edgeCases: repeated failures; partial model list; retry while another load pending.

steps: Send a prompt that fails (network drop) to get a 'Retry' button. Tap Retry, then immediately tap Retry again while in flight.
expected: Retry is disabled/hidden while state.sending (verifies retry-button-greyed-during-send); no double-send.
edgeCases: rapid double-tap; regenerate while sending; retry after success.

steps: Open 'Previous chats'. Search a non-matching query. Rename a conversation: clear the name to empty and observe Save, then enter a valid name.
expected: Search with no matches shows 'No chats match…' (verifies history-search-no-results-no-action); rename Save disabled when empty/whitespace (verifies rename-conversation-no-empty-guard); valid rename persists.
edgeCases: empty/whitespace rename; very long title; search special chars; no saved chats at all.

flow: AI image gen — generate, delete, clear all
steps: Switch to Image mode, pick an image model, enter a prompt, generate. Tap Delete on one image. Tap 'Clear all'.
expected: Image generates; Delete asks for confirmation (or offers Undo) before removing (verifies delete-image-no-confirmation); 'Clear all' shows a 'Delete all N images?' confirm (verifies clear-all-images-no-confirmation).
edgeCases: Image mode with no image model selected → Send disabled with explanation; delete the last image; clear-all on empty gallery; safe_mode NSFW behavior.

steps: Trigger a balance-fetch failure, then tap '⚠ Balance unknown — tap to refresh'. Separately, drive balance to 0, send to get 'Out of credit — Top up now', complete a top-up, return to the AI tab.
expected: Refresh shows an in-flight spinner/'Refreshing…' (verifies balance-unknown-refresh-no-loading-state); after a successful top-up the out-of-credit error auto-clears on balance refresh (verifies out-of-credit-error-persists).
edgeCases: repeated refresh taps; top-up pending; balance still 0 after refresh.

steps: Tap Top up. In the custom amount field type '0.50', then '0', then clear the field.
expected: Sub-dollar input is handled clearly — no silent '$1 USD' mismatch vs the typed value; validation requires a valid minimum; clearing the field hides instructions cleanly (verifies topup-custom-amount-rounding).
edgeCases: '0'; '0.50'; very large amount; empty field; non-numeric input.

steps: Open Address Book → Add contact. Enter a name and a valid address. Then test whitespace-only name and an address with leading/trailing spaces.
expected: Save/Confirm disabled for whitespace-only name; address trimmed consistently across Zashi and generic add flows (verifies contact-name-address-trim-inconsistency); contact appears in list non-blank.
edgeCases: whitespace name; padded address; duplicate address; max-length name; invalid address (validation error).

flow: Contacts/address book — edit/delete with stale contact
steps: Open Update Contact for an existing contact. Edit name/address and Update. Then reproduce the stale case: open Update for a contact that is deleted elsewhere before you act.
expected: Update enabled only when something actually changed AND originalContact exists; Update/Delete buttons are disabled (not dead) when the contact is missing (verifies update-contact-missing-contact-edge-case); editing whitespace-only name disables Save (verifies update-contact-name-trim-inconsistency).
edgeCases: contact deleted between open and update; no-op (no change) keeps Update disabled; whitespace name; invalid address.

steps: On a wallet with no contacts, open the Address Book / contact picker in compose.
expected: A clear empty state ('No contacts yet' + add affordance), no blank list, no crash.
edgeCases: 0 contacts; after deleting the last contact.

steps: From a chat, place a voice call Honor→Seeker. Accept on Seeker. During Dialling/Connecting rapidly tap hang-up ~3x. Toggle mute and audio output. Hang up.
expected: Call connects; rapid hang-up taps don't emit multiple HANGUP envelopes (verifies call-buttons-always-clickable); mute/audio-route work; single clean teardown.
edgeCases: rapid hang-up during state transition; accept then immediately hang up; caller cancels before answer.

steps: Place a video call Honor→Seeker with camera working. Then place a video call on a device where the camera fails to start (deny/disable camera).
expected: Working video shows both streams; when camera fails the UI falls back to the audio-call layout (no orphan video controls) — verifies video-fallback-ui-mismatch; if EGL init fails, an 'video unavailable' message shows rather than a silent black area (verifies no-egl-error-fallback).
edgeCases: camera permission granted but no camera; EGL init failure; switching camera mid-call.

steps: Enable TalkBack. During an active call, swipe to the call timer and open the audio-output dropdown; navigate the route items.
expected: Timer announces elapsed duration (verifies call-timer-missing-a11y); each audio route announces its name and selected state (verifies audio-route-menu-items-no-a11y).
edgeCases: selected vs available routes; route change announced; long call duration (>1h format).

steps: Open Settings → Reset ZCHAT (ResetZashiView). Without checking the acknowledgement checkbox, observe Confirm. Check it, then proceed to the confirmation screen and tap Reset; rapidly tap again.
expected: Confirm disabled until checkbox checked (verifies reset-zashi-checkbox-not-required); on the confirmation screen the Reset button disables + shows loading during reset, preventing multiple taps (verifies reset-zashi-confirm-button-no-disable-state).
edgeCases: uncheck after checking; rapid double-tap Reset; back during reset.

flow: Enhanced Destroy — full destructive flow + goodbye
steps: Open Enhanced Destroy. Step through CONFIRM_INTENT → review destruction items → ENTER_PIN → BIOMETRIC_VERIFY → GOODBYE_OPTION → countdown. On GOODBYE_OPTION with contacts, enable 'Send goodbye', type a message; also test with 0 contacts. Reach the countdown then Cancel.
expected: All steps localizable/readable; icons announce via TalkBack (verifies enhanced-destroy-icon-no-content-description); with 0 contacts the goodbye checkbox is disabled/hidden with correct grammar (verifies enhanced-destroy-goodbye-zero-contacts); goodbye messages are actually sent OR the feature is hidden/clearly marked unimplemented (verifies enhanced-destroy-goodbye-message-unimplemented); Cancel during countdown aborts destruction.
edgeCases: 0 contacts; wrong PIN; biometric cancel; cancel during countdown; many contacts; do NOT actually complete destruction on the primary test device — use a disposable wallet.

steps: Open Feedback. Select a sentiment emoji. Enter whitespace-only text and observe Send; then enter real text and Send. With TalkBack, navigate the emoji row. Repeat on a small-width device/emulator (320–360dp).
expected: Send disabled for whitespace-only text (verifies feedback-whitespace-enable); each emoji announces its sentiment via semantics (verifies feedback-emoji-no-semantics); emoji tap targets are >=48dp even on 320dp screens (verifies feedback-button-tap-size).
edgeCases: whitespace-only; very long feedback text; small screen tap targets; no emoji selected.

steps: Trigger the Insufficient Funds sheet (attempt a send exceeding balance). Rapidly tap OK multiple times.
expected: OK pops navigation exactly once (no multiple back-pops) — verifies insufficient-funds-no-button-state.
edgeCases: rapid multi-tap; back button vs OK; sheet dismissed by scrim.

steps: With network OFF, exercise: chat list load, open a chat, AI tab, Receive, Compose, Groups. Then turn network ON and retry each.
expected: Each screen shows a clear loading then either content or a recoverable error (message + Retry/Back) — no infinite spinners, no terminal dead-ends, no silent failures.
edgeCases: no network; slow network; transient failure then recovery; airplane mode mid-action.

steps: Set device language to Spanish (es). Open Receive, Enhanced Destroy, Chat detail, Call overlay, and the Destroy/PIN dialogs.
expected: After the i18n fix, these screens render Spanish (or at least pull from strings.xml) rather than hardcoded English — verifies i18n-hardcoded-strings-critical-screens.
edgeCases: es locale; RTL pseudo-locale; long translated strings overflowing buttons; missing translation falls back to default.
